sequence.content: Ho there, new delver! I'm Brewmaster Alehart, Keeper of the Far Mine tavern. The Far Mine is a cozy dwarf-made sim about digging, tinkering, and tales. Step to the hearth - say hello and share a favorite mining game or comfy sim you enjoy.

House rules: be kind, keep it SFW, get consent and give credit. Spoilers go in threads with a clear tag. Add alt text to images and gifs. Full rules live in {{channel.announcements}}. Action: read them and react on the rules post.

We build in public. Share WIPs in this hall: {{channel.build_in_public}}. A fresh weekly thread opens Fri 17:00 UTC. Start a subthread for your post; devs reply in threads to keep tidy. Action: drop your first reaction on the latest weekly thread.

Sprint 1: single mine level, basic mining and combat, 2 enemies, 3 crafting recipes, plus the tavern hub. See notes and tiny clips in {{channel.patch_notes}}. Action: skim the pinned sprint post so you know what's in-bounds.

Feedback welcome! Tags: [ui],[combat],[worldgen],[crafting],[audio],[lore]. Bug mini-format: version, seed, expected vs actual, clip if possible. We'll acknowledge within 48h. For repros, visit {{channel.bug_reports}}. Action: share one insight or bug.
